transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because I don’t really see things turning around. The studio, my life, all of it. No matter how hard I work or whatever payment plan they offer, it just feels like it’s not getting back on track.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy gray feeling. Even in the shop, around the wood and all that, it just feels… flat. I kind of have to push myself not to just stand there staring.
Do you find yourself enjoying things that you used to like doing?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it like that. Things just don’t feel like much lately, I guess.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but no longer find pleasure in?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I don’t do much besides work, so it’s hard to tell. Things just feel kind of dulled out, I guess.
Do you still find pleasure in working with wood?

Not really. I mean… I still go in and do the work, but it doesn’t feel the way it used to. Even with the wood around me, it’s just kind of flat. Some mornings that gray feeling’s already there before I even get started.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A little over two years, I guess. Since I took on the mortgage for the studio… about two years and a couple months.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasurable?

Not really. I mean… most days I wake up and it’s already there, that heavy gray feeling. Even in the shop, around the wood and all that, it just feels flat. I kind of have to push myself not to just stand there.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
Yeah… I guess I have. The wood used to mean something to me, and now most days I’m just there. It all feels kind of flat, like I’m forcing myself through it.
Have you experienced any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?
I don’t know… not anything I’ve really kept track of. Sleep’s… not great, I guess, but I can’t say exactly. Appetite, I haven’t noticed much.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed… maybe I’m slower some days, but I don’t know if it’s that or just feeling worn down. Sitting still, I guess I can do that fine.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
Not that I’ve really noticed. My clothes seem about the same, I think. I haven’t been checking or anything.
Do you feel like you've been restless or fidgety lately?
I don’t think so. I mean… I might shift around sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed being fidgety or anything.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve had anything specific like that. I’d rather not get into it too much.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you didn't feel that heavy gray feeling?

Not really. Most days it’s just… there when I wake up. That heavy gray feeling. Even at the shop, around the wood and all that, it just feels kind of flat. I mostly try to keep moving so I don’t just stand there.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of days?
No… not really. I keep waking up with that same heavy feeling, and it’s just there most of the day. Even being in the shop doesn’t really lift it much. It all feels kind of flat.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it that way. I mean, things feel bad, but… I don’t know. I’d rather not talk too much about that.
Are there any things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy at all?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really thought about it like that. Things just don’t feel like much lately.
Have you had any periods in the last two months where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of days?

No… I can’t say I’ve had a couple days where it really lifted. Most days I wake up and it’s just… that gray heaviness already there. Even at the shop, with the wood and everything, it still feels flat.
Have you had any periods in the last month where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of days?

No… not really. It’s been the same most days. I wake up and that heavy, gray feeling is already there. Even at the shop, around the wood and all that… it just feels flat. Sometimes I have to push myself not to just stand there.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt almost back to your normal self?
No… not really. These last couple weeks, I still wake up with that heavy, gray feeling on me. Even in the shop, with the wood and all, it just feels flat. I have to make myself keep moving sometimes.
